chunks: Whoever supplicates for forty men from among his brothers before supplicating for himself, his supplication will be answered regarding them and regarding himself.

key_terms.لِأَرْبَعِينَ: for forty, indicating a specific number in this teaching

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying for forty believers before praying for yourself?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of praying for fellow believers before praying for oneself. It highlights sincerity, brotherhood, and the special acceptance of du'a when one gives precedence to others.
